book.fruitfulfun.guide.beekeeping.bee_in: A whole new way to play with bees.

A bee's traits determine its abilities and temperament.\
\
Some bees are faster, some are gentle, some are skilled fighters, and some can even be ridden. These traits are decided by their genes and can be passed on to offspring.

Use a Honeycomb on a bee nest or beehive, and for a time afterward you can mine the block as if holding a Silk Touch tool without angering the bees inside.\
\
After leashing a bee, press the use key on a bee nest or beehive to send the bee home at once.\
\
Blow a specific Goat Horn to send nearby bees home at once.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.beekeeping.geneti: The essential tool for studying bee traits and genes.

The Buzzy Inspector is the essential tool for studying bees. Hold the interact key on a bee to see its traits, genotype, and carried pollen.<#if cfg:fruitfulfun.common.inspectorShowOffspringPotential> Interacting while sneaking locks onto a bee; when you then analyze other bees, it shows the possible trait changes of their offspring with the locked bee.<#endif>\
\
Hold a Book and Quill in your off hand and use it on a bee to write the record into the book. Use it on a bookshelf to give a gene code a new name.

Mutagen can greatly increase the mutation rate of a specific gene in offspring. To use it, interact with a parent while holding the mutagen before breeding.
<#if cfg:fruitfulfun.common.mutagenRecipe>\
\
Mutagen is brewed from Pitcher Plants<#if cfg:fruitfulfun.common.imperfectMutagenChance!=0>, and there is a chance the brewing fails. Spoiled mutagen is unusable, but it can be recycled into Glass Bottles<#endif>.
<#endif>
<#if FFBeekeeper>Beekeepers<#else>Wandering Traders<#endif> will sometimes buy beehives with bees from you. The rarer the bees' traits, the higher their offer.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.beekeeping.haunti: The wondrous power of possession and control.

If you want to drive away the troublemaker possessing you, you need to stand in fire and take damage for a while (by testing, Soul Fire works immediately). A possessor is most vulnerable at the moment it releases the possession, taking increased damage while wounded.

A Ghost Bee lets your soul "possess" other creatures, forever watching their actions through the possessed one's eyes.\
\
To possess something, first interact with a Ghost Bee to possess it, then steer it close to your target as quickly as you can. Interact with the target to possess it. Press the sneak key while possessing to release the possession at once.
The Secret of the Ghost Bee
book.fruitfulfun.guide.beekeeping.name: Beekeeping
book.fruitfulfun.guide.beekeeping.riding: A niche mode of transport that has both speed and style.

You can put a saddle on a bee that has the "Rideable" trait, then ride it<#if cfg:fruitfulfun.common.beeRiding.heightLimit> at low altitude<#endif>. Generally, only adult bees you have bred trust you enough to let you ride them.
<#if cfg:fruitfulfun.common.beeRiding.rainingLimit || cfg:fruitfulfun.common.beeRiding.beeRidingEnvironmentAttrRules>\
\
Riding bees also has some environmental restrictions.<#if cfg:fruitfulfun.common.beeRiding.rainingLimit> For example, a bee without "Rain Capable" cannot be ridden in the rain.<#endif>
<#endif>\
\
Use Shears on a bee to take off the saddle.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.cooking.chorus_fr: A Chorus Fruit Pie imbued with mysterious power.

Travelers of the End mash Chorus Fruit into a purple paste, wrap it in pastry, and bake it in an oven. The taste is said to be less than pleasant; some claim that after eating it, the muddled grumbles of End creatures echo in their mind for a long time.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.cooking.descripti: Turn a bountiful harvest into delicious dishes.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.cooking.donauwell: A classic cake woven from Redlove Fruit and chocolate.

Cocoa, eggs, and cream layer into waves, and the cut surface spills out rivers of deep red and dark brown. Redlove Fruit float like little boats down the long river of chocolate. Some say that eating this cake lets you hear a waltz from the beyond; others say it is only the ringing ears of hunger.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.cooking.grapefrui: A silky panna cotta made from Grapefruit.

The tartness of Grapefruit, the softness of cream, eggs, and gelatin together set into a quiet moon. Legend says it was born from a witch's cauldron mishap: meaning to brew a potion, she made a dessert instead. It tastes bitter first and sweet after, like finding diamonds in an abandoned mine. Villagers say that after eating it, even thunder grows gentle.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.cooking.honey_pom: A hot drink that clears harmful effects.

Honey and Pomelo simmer into a golden hot drink, curling wisps of steam rising. One sip brings unbidden memories of that fine afternoon when bees danced in the sunlight. If you ask me, this, not gulping from a bucket of milk, is the elegant choice of the old-fashioned adventurer.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.cooking.lemon_roa: A whole chicken is rubbed with Lemon juice and herbs and turned slowly over a grill until the skin is crisp as a gold ingot. Bite in, and tang and juices burst together like festival fireworks on your tongue. The chef insists the secret is not the heat, but saying "good night" to the chicken.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.cooking.name: Cooking
book.fruitfulfun.guide.cooking.rice_with: Fragrant, tasty Steamed Rice with Fruits in Bamboo.

Split open a green bamboo stalk, and steam rushes out carrying the whispers of the orchard. Colorful bits of fruit weave through the soft, sticky grains. Chew slowly, and you taste the freshness of jungle dew along with the full strength that grain gives. Travelers often carry a section on the road; one bite and it feels less like stone bricks underfoot and more like soft grass.
Steamed Rice with Fruits in Bamboo
Steamed Rice with Fruits in Bamboo
book.fruitfulfun.guide.description:
Welcome to Fruitful Fun!\
\
This is a casual mod themed around fruits and beekeeping. Click the categories on the right to browse the topics that interest you.\
\
Some of the mod's content is still in development. Stay tuned.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.fruit_tree.descri: From planting to hybridizing, cultivate every fruit tree step by step.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.fruit_tree.fruit_:
Eating citrus fruits puts out the fire on you.\
\
Lemon restores less hunger, but can be eaten the fastest and restores the most saturation.

Pomegranate cannot be eaten.\
\
If a Pomegranate lands on the ground and is not collected in time, it vanishes and produces an explosion that deals almost no damage but has strong knockback.
Redlove Fruit restores a little health and shortens a mob's breeding cooldown.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.fruit_tree.gettin:
<#if cfg:fruitfulfun.common.appleSaplingFromHeroOfTheVillage && cfg:fruitfulfun.common.villageAppleTreeWorldGen>
Apple Oak Saplings have a rather special source. After you become the hero of a village, baby villagers will give you Apple Oak Saplings. They also occasionally appear at the center of plains villages.
<#elif cfg:fruitfulfun.common.appleSaplingFromHeroOfTheVillage>
Apple Oak Saplings have a rather special source. After you become the hero of a village, baby villagers will give you Apple Oak Saplings.
<#elif cfg:fruitfulfun.common.villageAppleTreeWorldGen>
Apple Oak Saplings have a rather special source. They only occasionally appear at the center of plains villages.
<#else>
Under the current config, the default sources of Apple Oak Saplings are disabled.
<#endif>
An introduction to how to obtain each kind of sapling.

Unlocking more rare varieties requires the help of bees.\
\
Let bees carry pollen from different sources to pollinate fruit trees, and you may get leaves bearing entirely new fruits. Breaking these special leaves has a chance to yield saplings of that fruit.\
\
See [Hybridizing Fruit Trees](entry://fruitfulfun:guide/fruit_tree/hybridizing) for details.

In the world (mainly in warm forests), you may find scattered Citron, Orange, and Lime trees. They mostly look like oak trees, but have distinctive flowers and fruits among their leaves. These basic varieties are indispensable material for cultivating rare fruits later.
<#if cfg:fruitfulfun.common.wanderingTraderSaplingPrice >= 1>\
\
If trekking far from home feels like too much trouble, you can also buy these saplings from Wandering Traders.
<#endif>
book.fruitfulfun.guide.fruit_tree.hybrid: Cultivate entirely new tree species with pollen.

Bees carry the pollen they most recently collected. When a bee pollinates another plant while carrying a specific combination of pollen, it can produce unexpected effects, hybridization among them. As long as the pollen combination is correct, hybridization always succeeds, but breaking the leaves to get a new sapling takes a bit of luck.\
\
Some higher-tier hybridization processes require bees with the "Advanced Pollination" trait.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.fruit_tree.name: Fruit Trees
book.fruitfulfun.guide.fruit_tree.planti: Some fruit trees need bee pollination to bear fruit. You can check which fruit trees have this trait in the tooltip of their sapling or leaves.
Essential knowledge for the expert farmer.

Besides picking by hand, you can also harvest with a Goat Horn.\
\
Blow a specific Goat Horn and all the fruits on nearby fruit trees will fall.

Fruit trees cannot bear fruit forever. Every attempt to grow fruit reduces the tree's lifespan. Without human care, a fruit tree will eventually stop bearing fruit.\
\
If you break the trunk or the leaves at the top of a fruit tree, it immediately stops bearing fruit.
<#if bee>\
\
Keeping bees doing ordinary pollination on the leaves (without hybridizing) lets a fruit tree bear fruit forever.
<#endif>
book.fruitfulfun.guide.name: Fruitful Fun Guide
book.fruitfulfun.guide.ritual.descriptio: Hold an ancient ritual with Dragon Heads and candlelight.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.ritual.dragon_rit:
To build the ritual site, you need at least 1 Dragon Head, 1 Chorus Fruit Pie, and 12 candles of any kind. The arrangement is shown in the image.\
\
You must place the Chorus Fruit Pie last to start the ritual. Once it begins, toss the item you want to transform into the center as quickly as possible.\
\
If you fail to toss an item in time, extra Dragon's Breath will appear on the ground. More Dragon Heads (up to 4) means more Dragon's Breath produced. Be careful not to get hurt by the Dragon's Breath.
The image shows the complete ritual structure.

The ritual can transform an item into another item. Here are some known recipes:\
\
Glass Bottle → Dragon's Breath\
Pomegranate → Enchanted Pomegranate
<#if gadget>\
Brewing Stand → [Brewer](entry://fruitfulfun:guide/tools/brewer)\
Daylight Detector → [Rain Detector](entry://fruitfulfun:guide/tools/rain_detector)
<#endif>
book.fruitfulfun.guide.ritual.name: Ritual
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.brewer.desc: A brewer that brews automatically and speeds up.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.brewer.intr:
The Brewer automatically outputs products into the container below.\
\
Brewing the same product continuously makes it brew faster and faster, up to a +100%% speed bonus.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.brewer.name: Brewer
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.buzzy_craft:
The Buzzy Crafter collects power from returning bees and channels that power into the items or blocks above it.\
\
Automating this process is easy: drop items above the crafter and they will be pulled into the container automatically. Place a full block above the crafter, and the items in the container will be ejected from beneath it.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.buzzy_shiel: A shield that can summon a swarm of bees.

A shield forged from Honeycomb.\
\
Raising the shield only blocks half the damage. But a perfect block (raising the shield the moment before you are hit) blocks all damage, knocks back nearby enemies, and summons a swarm of bees to strike back at the attacker.\
\
Every block consumes [Energy](entry://fruitfulfun:guide/tools/buzzy_shield). Watch the energy display on the shield.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.description: Practical machines and gear that make life more convenient.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.market.desc: A shop that automatically stocks goods to order.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.market.intr:
The Market Block is a shop that automatically stocks agricultural products. You only need to deposit money and place orders; at sunrise each day it restocks the ordered goods and waits for you to collect them.\
\
Put currency into the slot on the right side of the interface to deposit money. Hover over that slot to see the supported currencies and their denominations.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.market.name: Market Block
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.market.orde:
After clicking the "Order" button, left-click any slot to open the goods catalog, then choose an item and quantity to place an order; right-click a slot to cancel the order. Orders are shown as semi-transparent items.\
\
The catalog only lists items you have seen before: items you have held, crafted, used, or dropped, and that have a price.\
\
At sunrise of each in-game day, the Market restocks according to your orders using the money it holds, until it is fully restocked or the money runs out.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.name: Tools
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.rain_detect: A redstone block that detects rainfall.
It works much like a Daylight Detector, except it outputs a redstone signal based on rainfall intensity.
book.fruitfulfun.guide.tools.scented_can:
Light a Scented Candle, and the magic it gives off affects the surrounding chunks. Depending on how many candles are stacked, the affected area can grow from 1 chunk up to 7×7 chunks.\
\
Scented Candles consume energy to keep burning. You can place a candle on a [Buzzy Crafter](entry://fruitfulfun:guide/tools/buzzy_crafter) to charge it and keep it working at the same time.
<#if bee>\
\
Using a Buzzy Inspector on the ground shows the scents active in the current chunk.
<#endif>
